title: M4 Helios civilian fleet candidates (Lark / Cradle / Span)

productionPolicy: Candidates live under assets/ships/m4_helios_civilian only. Do not overwrite K0 Kestrel or Ashline assets. Integration requires controller review + manifest lease.
qualityBar: SF-K0 Borrowed Time minimum; Ashline is failure-comparison only
